semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: MongoDB connection & Atlas boundary
subtitle: Verified connection code; hosted cluster topology explicitly unverified

nodes.label: Database operation requested
nodes.description: Server code requests a shared MongoDB connection.

nodes.label: MONGODB_URI supplied?
nodes.description: Absence rejects live operations; no credentials are displayed.

nodes.label: Shared native-driver pool
nodes.description: MongoClient.connect, maxPoolSize 10 and serverSelectionTimeoutMS 6000 are actual code settings.

nodes.label: Hosted cluster / Atlas boundary
nodes.description: MongoDB hosting, Atlas cluster tier, region, replica placement and network access rules cannot be inferred from the connection code.

nodes.label: Database selection and transaction
nodes.description: MONGODB_DB override or ovia default; writes can share ClientSession.withTransaction.

nodes.label: Repository result returned
nodes.description: Stored records or a surfaced database error return to business services.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
The hosted-cluster node is a trust boundary, not proof of an Atlas deployment. No private network, replica topology or production configuration has been invented.
